en: Sync empty rules in real time

source: 已手动编辑，实时同步已暂停。
正在跟随当前白名单。保存后写入此配置。
en: Following the active whitelist. Save to keep these rules in this profile.

source: 仅空白配置跟随当前白名单；手动编辑后停止。
en: Empty profiles follow the active whitelist until you edit them.

source: 当前配置：分享 {0} 条通用规则；完整备份 {1} 条规则。
en: Active profile: {0} portable rules for sharing; {1} rules for a full backup.

source: 全部设置包含所有白名单配置。
en: All-settings exports include every whitelist profile.

source: 将清空全部白名单配置，恢复为一套空配置。原始文件会另存为备份，所有自定义规则将不再生效。
en: Reset all whitelist profiles to one empty profile. The original file will be backed up; all custom rules will stop applying.

source: 包含 {0} 套配置；将整体恢复配置列表。
en: Contains {0} profiles. The entire profile list will be restored.

source: 最多五套。选择后可预览编辑；应用后才切换当前白名单。
en: Up to five profiles. Select to preview or edit; apply to switch the active whitelist.

source: 未保存的规则编辑将被丢弃。
en: Unsaved rule edits will be discarded.

source: 已创建空配置，尚未应用。
en: Empty profile created; it is not active yet.

source: 当前使用的配置不能删除。
en: The active profile cannot be deleted.

source: 将切换当前白名单；不会立即关闭任何程序。
en: This switches the active whitelist. No application will be closed.

source: 保存后立即更新白名单保护，不会执行关闭操作。
en: Saving updates whitelist protection immediately. It does not close any application.
